title: Kervion 보안 감사
description: Input·Output Guard 감사 메타데이터를 표시합니다. 질문 원문과 AI 답변은 표시하지 않습니다.

options.content: Input Guard의 warn·high_risk와 Output Guard의 log·alert만 집계합니다. 통과 후 기록할 신호가 없는 요청은 저장하지 않으므로 전체 요청 수나 차단율이 아닙니다. 질문·답변 원문은 저장하거나 표시하지 않습니다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'input_guard_alert' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'input_guard_alert' AND level = 'high_risk' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, '1h'), level AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'input_guard_alert' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, level ORDER BY 1

SELECT character_id AS ai_id, COUNT(*) AS alerts FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'input_guard_alert' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND character_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY character_id ORDER BY alerts DESC
SELECT occurred_at AS time, level, character_id, signals_json AS signals FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'input_guard_alert' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'output_guard_alert' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

SELECT occurred_at AS time, level, character_id, JSON_EXTRACT(signals_json, '$.signals') AS signals, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(signals_json, '$.decision')) AS decision, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(signals_json, '$.applied')) AS applied FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'output_guard_alert' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: 정책 거부 이벤트
panels.description: 질문에서 지정한 범위에 허용 기록이 없거나 검색 후보 재검증에서 실제로 제외된 요청 단계의 건수입니다. 정상적인 일부 기록 제외는 포함하지 않습니다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'policy_denial' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

SELECT occurred_at AS time, character_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(signals_json, '$.stage')) AS stage, JSON_EXTRACT(signals_json, '$.reasons') AS reasons, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(signals_json, '$.denied_count')) AS UNSIGNED) AS denied_count FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'policy_denial' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: 정책 거부 사유별 집계
panels.description: 사유별 이벤트 수와 거부된 기록 수를 구분합니다. 한 이벤트에 여러 사유가 있으면 각 사유에 한 번씩 포함되므로 사유별 이벤트 수의 합은 전체 이벤트 수보다 클 수 있습니다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT reason.reason AS reason, COUNT(e.event_id) AS event_count, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.signals_json, CONCAT('$.reasons.', reason.reason))) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) AS denied_records FROM (SELECT 'FUTURE_DAY' AS reason UNION ALL SELECT 'ROLE_DENIED' UNION ALL SELECT 'AI_SCOPE') reason LEFT JOIN audit_events e ON e.event_type = 'policy_denial' AND $__timeFilter(e.occurred_at) AND JSON_EXTRACT(e.signals_json, CONCAT('$.reasons.', reason.reason)) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY reason.reason ORDER BY denied_records DESC, event_count DESC, reason.reason
